concept.title: Getting started
concept.shortdesc: shows you the people around you who share your interests and lets you match, chat, call, and leave notes, all phone to phone, with no internet, no signal, and no account.

conbody.p: There is no phone number, email address, or password. Your profile lives on your phone, and everything you share travels directly between phones that are close together.

ul.li: An iPhone running or later. iPad isn't supported.
Bluetooth and Wi-Fi turned on. You don't need a Wi-Fi network or mobile data.

ol.li: Turn on Nearby to see the people around you who have open.
Say hi to someone. If they say hi back, you match.
Chat, call, or leave a note at a place for them to find.
